messages:
Laura (People Ops): Quick heads-up — were publishing the localized handbook v2 for EMEA/APAC next week. Need quick confirmations on the compliance sections and to lock training slots. Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/localization (please open before EOD).
Mike R (HR Ops): Thanks Laura — is this just translations or are we changing policy content too?
Laura (People Ops): Mostly localization + a few policy clarifications for leave accrual and expense caps in region-specific sections. No changes to core code of conduct. See changelog in the doc.
Sasha J (EMEA People Partner): I can review the EMEA leave wording. Can you drop the spreadsheet of managers who need to acknowledge?
Laura (People Ops): Added manager RSVP sheet here: https://sheets.goo.gl/Redwood-EMEA-ACKS — please fill the ‘manager confirmed’ column by Fri.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: Mandatory compliance session "Handbook v2 overview" scheduled. Use /rsvp to pick a slot. (automated)
Mike R (HR Ops): Will run two live sessions: Tue 0900 UTC and Thu 1500 UTC. Both 30 min, recording posted.
Sasha J (EMEA People Partner): Ill take Tue for APAC overlap. @Mike R can you set calendar invites and include the manager RSVP sheet link?
Mike R (HR Ops): Yup — invites going out in 10m. Also added a quick manager checklist snippet to the sheet.
Laura (People Ops): Manager checklist (paste into sheet):
```
- Confirm localized leave language with HR
- Ensure team completes e-sign ack
- Book follow-up 1:1 if questions
```
Eli (Legal): Quick note — expense cap change needs a one-line statutory caveat for DE/FR. I added comment in the doc at section 4.2.
Sasha J (EMEA People Partner): Got Eli's comment. Ill update the German wording and ping legal for sign-off.
Mike R (HR Ops): One operational ask: hiring ops — please flag any open reqs that reference old handbook benefits. We need to update JD language before posting.
Laura (People Ops): Good catch. Hiring leads: search for "parental leave" and "relocation" in active reqs and tag me by EOD.
OnboardingBot: Automated ack tracker: 12/48 managers confirmed, 3 sessions full, recording link to follow. :white_check_mark:
Laura (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you cant make Tuesday session, mark the RSVP and well assign a catch-up. Final deadline for all manager acks: next Fri 18:00 UTC.
Mike R (HR Ops): Noted. Ill post a quick reminder in #general 24h before deadline.
Sasha J (EMEA People Partner): Will follow up with people leads in EMEA to push confirmations. :thumbsup:
Eli (Legal): Ill sign off on the DE/FR caveat by tomorrow morning.
Laura (People Ops): Perfect — I'll close the doc Friday morning and export the ack report. Thanks team! :sparkles:
